ruleDefinitions.name: Scheduled Task Creation Via Schtasks.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of scheduled tasks by user accounts via the "schtasks" utility.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*")) AND  NOT ((user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*")))
